translationRepairs: Jin chancellor Li Song had gone north with the Khitan. When the High Ancestor entered the capital he gave Song’s mansion to Fengji—and took Song’s fields and houses in the Western Capital as well.

Jin chancellor Li Song had gone north with the Khitan. When the High Ancestor entered the capital he gave Song’s mansion to Fengji; Song also had fields and houses in the Western Capital, and Fengji took those as well.

Focus unit gives Song’s mansion by the High Ancestor (以崧第賜逢吉) then states Song also had Western Capital estates and 逢吉遂皆取之; the before text wrongly keeps the High Ancestor as subject of the seizure, and the after correctly assigns it to Fengji.
Zhang Lingrou, Yanzhou’s bandit-hunter, then slaughtered several hundred people across seventeen villages in Pingyin County.
Zhang Lingrou, Yunzhou’s bandit-hunter, then slaughtered several hundred people across seventeen villages in Pingyin County.
Focus unit names 鄆州捕賊使者; 鄆州 is Yunzhou, so Yanzhou (兗州) is a wrong place name and Yunzhou is the accurate repair.
Thereupon Zhang Lingrou, the Yanzhou bandit-capture envoy, killed altogether several hundred villagers of seventeen villages in Pingyin County.
Thereupon Zhang Lingrou, the Yunzhou bandit-capture envoy, killed altogether several hundred villagers of seventeen villages in Pingyin County.
The literal field has the same error: 鄆州 must be Yunzhou, not Yanzhou.
Qianyou year two brought him the Grand Marshal’s seal.
In Qianyou year two he was additionally appointed Minister of Works.
Focus unit says 加拜司空; 司空 is Minister of Works, not Grand Marshal (太尉), and the after correctly renders the additional appointment.
In the second year of Qianyou he was additionally appointed Grand Marshal.
In the second year of Qianyou he was additionally appointed Minister of Works.
The literal field likewise misrenders 司空 as Grand Marshal; Minister of Works matches the Chinese.

Fengji spent the night in the eastern wing of the Jinxian Hall and told Wang Chune, the Summer Office director of astronomy: “Last night, before dusk, I saw Li Song beside me—the living keeping company with the dead. Nothing good can come of that.”

Fengji spent the night in the eastern wing of the Jinxiang Hall and told Wang Chune, the Summer Office director of astronomy: “Last night, before dusk, I saw Li Song beside me—the living keeping company with the dead. Nothing good can come of that.”
Focus unit has 金祥殿; 祥 is xiang, so Jinxiang Hall is correct and Jinxian wrongly reads the graph as if 仙.

Fengji lodged by night in the eastern wing of the Jinxian Hall and said to Wang Chune, Director of the Directorate of Astronomy’s Summer Office: “Last night before dark I already saw Li Song at my side—the living meeting the dead: nothing auspicious.”

Fengji lodged by night in the eastern wing of the Jinxiang Hall and said to Wang Chune, Director of the Directorate of Astronomy’s Summer Office: “Last night before dark I already saw Li Song at my side—the living meeting the dead: nothing auspicious.”
The literal field has the same hall-name error; 金祥殿 is Jinxiang Hall, not Jinxian Hall.
In Liang’s last days seven households furnished one soldier. Hongzhao served under the Kaifeng circuit commander and was chosen for the palace guard.
In Liang’s last days seven households furnished one soldier. Hongzhao served in the Kaidao Command and was chosen for the palace guard.
Focus unit attaches Hongzhao to 開道指揮; that is the Kaidao Command, not a Kaifeng circuit commander.
At the end of Liang, seven households were levied for one soldier; Hongzhao became a soldier, attached to the Kaifeng circuit commander, and was selected for the palace guard.
At the end of Liang, seven households were levied for one soldier; Hongzhao became a soldier, attached to the Kaidao Command, and was selected for the palace guard.
The literal field likewise invents Kaifeng for 開道指揮; Kaidao Command matches the Chinese unit name.

Under the Deposed Emperor, Li Shouzhen of Hezhong, Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang, Zhao Sixian of Yongxing, and others rebelled. War opened in the western passes; fear ran through the realm. In the capital rumor fed rumor.

Under the Deposed Emperor, Li Shouzhen of Hezhong, Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang, Zhao Siwan of Yongxing, and others rebelled. War opened in the western passes; fear ran through the realm. In the capital rumor fed rumor.
Focus unit names 趙思綰; 綰 is wǎn, so Zhao Siwan is correct and Sixian is a false reading of the given name.

In the Deposed Emperor’s time Li Shouzhen of Hezhong, Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang, Zhao Sixian of Yongxing, and others all rebelled. War was waged in the western passes; hearts were fearful. The people of the capital, by rumor, alarmed one another.

In the Deposed Emperor’s time Li Shouzhen of Hezhong, Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang, Zhao Siwan of Yongxing, and others all rebelled. War was waged in the western passes; hearts were fearful. The people of the capital, by rumor, alarmed one another.
The literal field has the same romanization error for 趙思綰; Zhao Siwan restores the correct reading.
He Yan Fujin of Yan had a jade pillow worth 140,000 cash; he sent a page to sell it in Huainan to trade for tea.
He Fujin of Yan had a jade pillow worth 140,000 cash; he sent a page to sell it in Huainan to trade for tea.
Focus unit says 燕人何福進: 燕人 marks origin and 何福進 is the name; “He Yan Fujin” wrongly folds the place into the personal name, and He Fujin of Yan is accurate.
Qu Wen of the Yongzhou yeast office and the officer He Zheng quarreled over duty and sued before the Three Departments, which ruled for Wen.
Qu Wen of the Yingzhou yeast office and the officer He Zheng quarreled over duty and sued before the Three Departments, which ruled for Wen.
Focus unit has 潁州麹場官; 潁州 is Yingzhou, so Yongzhou is a wrong prefecture name.
The Yongzhou yeast-works officer Qu Wen and the army officer He Zheng disputed official business and sued at the Three Departments; the Three Departments ruled for Wen.
The Yingzhou yeast-works officer Qu Wen and the army officer He Zheng disputed official business and sued at the Three Departments; the Three Departments ruled for Wen.
The literal field likewise misrenders 潁州 as Yongzhou; Yingzhou matches the Chinese and the following unit’s Ying.

When the western war ended the Deposed Emperor drifted toward petty favorites—Hou Zan, Li Ye, and the rest—and played without restraint. The dowager’s kin peddled influence; Hongzhao and Yang Bin checked them where they could.

When the western war ended the Hidden Emperor drifted toward petty favorites—Hou Zan, Li Ye, and the rest—and played without restraint. The dowager’s kin peddled influence; Hongzhao and Yang Bin checked them where they could.
Focus unit names 隱帝; that is the Hidden Emperor (Emperor Yin), not the Deposed Emperor (廢帝), so the title repair is required.
At enthronement Zhang became Three Departments commissioner and Acting Grand General.
At enthronement Zhang became Three Departments commissioner and Acting Grand Commandant.
Focus unit has 檢校太尉; 太尉 is Grand Commandant, not Grand General, and Acting Grand Commandant matches 檢校太尉.
The High Ancestor died; the Hidden Emperor made Zhang Grand General and Associate Grand Councilor.
The High Ancestor died; the Hidden Emperor made Zhang Grand Commandant and Associate Grand Councilor.
Focus unit adds 太尉; the same office must be Grand Commandant, not Grand General.
Guo Wei meant to win hearts and asked his ministers: “Vice Director Liu fell hard from his horse; soldiers humiliated him, yet he lives. I would ask the dowager to spare his family—what say you?”
Guo Wei meant to win hearts and asked his ministers: “Palace Attendant Liu fell hard from his horse; soldiers humiliated him, yet he lives. I would ask the dowager to spare his family—what say you?”
The quoted title is 劉侍中; 侍中 is Palace Attendant, not Vice Director, so Palace Attendant Liu is the correct repair.

At that time Taizu wished to win hearts and discussed with his ministers: “Vice Director Liu fell from his horse and was badly hurt; soldiers pressed and humiliated him, yet he barely lives. I wish to memorialize the dowager and spare his household—what do you think?”

At that time Taizu wished to win hearts and discussed with his ministers: “Palace Attendant Liu fell from his horse and was badly hurt; soldiers pressed and humiliated him, yet he barely lives. I wish to memorialize the dowager and spare his household—what do you think?”
The literal field has the same 侍中 error; Palace Attendant Liu matches the Chinese title.
He stayed Zhu’s death. Li Ye and the rest were exposed in the market; their wives and children were spared.
He then killed only Zhu; Zhu, with Li Ye and the rest, had their heads exposed in the market, and their wives and children were pardoned.

Focus unit 乃止殺銖，與李業等梟首於市，赦其妻子 means the killing was limited to Zhu, who was beheaded and exposed with Li Ye and the rest while wives and children were pardoned; “stayed Zhu’s death” reverses the sense, and the after restores it.
He then stayed Zhu’s execution and, with Li Ye and the rest, exposed their heads in the market; their wives and children were pardoned.
He then limited the killing to Zhu and, with Li Ye and the rest, exposed their heads in the market; their wives and children were pardoned.
The literal “stayed Zhu’s execution” likewise reverses 止殺銖; limiting the killing to Zhu and exposing heads with Li Ye matches the Chinese.
Li Ye was brother to the High Ancestor’s empress.
Li Ye was the younger brother of the High Ancestor’s empress.
Focus unit says 高祖皇后之弟; 弟 is specifically younger brother, and the following unit confirms Ye was youngest, so omitting “younger” drops kinship specificity the Chinese marks.
Guo Wei rebelled. The emperor sent Yuan Gui and Yan Jinqing against him at Chanyuan.
Guo Wei rebelled. The emperor sent Yuan Xue and Yan Jinqing against him at Chanyuan.
Focus unit names 袁泬; 泬 is read Xuè, so Yuan Xue is correct and Yuan Gui is a false romanization.
Wei raised troops in rebellion. The Hidden Emperor sent Left Divine Martial Commander Yuan Gui, Palace Horse Guard Commander Yan Jinqing, and the rest to lead troops against Wei at Chanyuan.
Wei raised troops in rebellion. The Hidden Emperor sent Left Divine Martial Commander Yuan Xue, Palace Horse Guard Commander Yan Jinqing, and the rest to lead troops against Wei at Chanyuan.
The literal field has the same error for 袁泬; Yuan Xue restores the correct reading of 泬.
Han fell at the northern suburb. Ye stuffed the inner treasury’s gold into his robes and fled to his brother Hongxin at Baoyi; Hongxin turned him away.
When Han’s army was defeated at the northern suburb, Ye stuffed the inner treasury’s gold into his robes and fled to his brother Hongxin at Baoyi; Hongxin turned him away.
Focus unit says 漢兵敗於北郊: the Han army was defeated, not that the Han polity fell; the after removes the invented dynastic-collapse reading.
Guo Yunming was raised a steward in the Han High Ancestor’s household. The High Ancestor favored him and made him Hanlin Commissioner of Tea and Wine.
Guo Yunming had from youth been a steward in the Han High Ancestor’s household. The High Ancestor favored him and made him Hanlin Commissioner of Tea and Wine.
Focus unit 少為漢高祖廝養 means he served as a household steward from youth; “was raised a steward” invents a rearing sense the Chinese does not have, and the after matches 少為.
